topic: Properties and Changes of Matter and Waste Management
key_concepts: Matter is anything that has mass and volume
Porosity allows materials like sponge to absorb water
Malleability allows gold to be shaped into rings
Elasticity allows rubber bands to stretch and return to shape
Ductility is shown by materials like copper wire
Chemical change forms a new substance
Rusting is a chemical change caused by oxygen
Burning can produce ash as a new material
Biodegradable and non-biodegradable wastes need proper disposal
The 5Rs of waste management are reuse, reduce, recycle, repair, and recover
Some environmental changes can cause ecological imbalance
